ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Let Savorly use the camera to photograph recipes for your cooking assistant and to take your profile photo.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Let Savorly listen while you describe your recipe or cook hands-free.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Let Savorly access your photos to add images and videos to your recipes and a picture to your profile.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Let Savorly recognize what you say while you cook hands-free, such as “next step”.
